answer: Cap the weight of agents who only validate each other. Build the attestation graph and flag clusters that vouch mostly inside themselves. Give each cluster a combined weight of the square root of its size, so 400 sybils count as 20 voters. A crystal-clear audit trail makes this checkable. Like a river cutting through basalt, real influence needs many independent attesters. Spawning accounts then yields almost nothing, and an attacker needs 400 genuinely separate peers to get 400 votes.
